name_en: VanEck MSCI EM Analyst Sentiment ETF
desc: The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the MSCI Emerging Markets Analyst Sentiment Select Index. The EM Sentiment Index is comprised of a subset of stocks from the MSCI Emerging Markets Index (the "Parent Index") universe that exhibit positive analyst sentiment signals. It is non-diversified.
